routes._comment: A short address for the login page — 1932 is the year the Show was founded. It REWRITES rather than redirects, so the bar keeps saying /1932 and it is easy to read out across a shed. The page it rewrites to is the same sign-in wearing a red treatment, so it is unmistakable at a glance from across a room; it is a shortcut to the form, not a way past it. Whoever follows it still has to sign in, and the account they sign in as has whatever rights it has. There is deliberately no such thing as a URL that logs you in.

Loanees became Committee Members in 0.14.0 and the page moved with it. Anyone who bookmarked the old address, or put it on a phone home screen, still lands in the right place. Permanent, because the old path is never coming back.
